result.reason: The revision reaches the fallback position by retaining annual automatic renewals while reducing the non-renewal/termination notice period to 30 days, below the 60-day maximum. The clause grants no renewal price-increase right, which is at least as protective as a 5% cap. The change is narrow and preserves the remaining termination framework. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits the 60-day Vendor reminder and an express CPI/3% cap. Drafting is generally professional, though “elect not to renew any renewal term ... following the Initial Term” is somewhat awkward and could more clearly state when notice may be delivered, particularly for the first renewal.
